title: Vendor Payment Schedule
dataSources: Planning tasks (`event:task`), budget lines (`event:budget`), RSVPs (`event:rsvp`), vendor bookings (`event:vendor`), countdown milestones (`event:countdown`).
app: Wedding and event planning — task and budget spreadsheets, RSVP platforms (Zola, The Knot), vendor contracts, and seating tools — streamed to Splunk HEC via CSV exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=event:vendor
| eval days_to_payment=round((next_payment_due-now())/86400,1)
| where days_to_payment<30
| table vendor next_payment_due amount_due days_to_payment
| sort days_to_payment
description: Lists upcoming vendor deposits and final payments so no supplier bill catches you by surprise.
value: Missing a vendor deadline can cost a booking; an early payment calendar protects your key suppliers.
implementation: Ingest vendor contracts and due dates into `index=personal`; surface payments due soon.
visualization: Table of vendor payments due in the next 30 days.
grandmaExplanation: It lists which suppliers need paying soon and how much, so no deposit or final bill sneaks up on you.
